name: bash
description:
- Executes a system command in a controlled environment
- Runs the command synchronously and returns stdout/stderr and the exit code
- Automatically truncates large outputs to protect context window (keeps the last 2000 lines; the full output is written to a temp file whose path is reported)
- Commands are always run through `bash -c`; on Windows this is Git Bash
- Use this tool when you need to run shell commands, build scripts, run tests, or perform other system-level operations

command.description: The exact bash command to execute.
